title: Equivariant lifting of fixed-point automorphisms for free compact-group C-star actions exactly when the twisted factor systems are conjugate
author: Kay Schwieger; Stefan Wagner
source_title: An Atiyah Sequence for Noncommutative Principal Bundles
difficulty_reason: The proof reconstructs a total-space automorphism from compatible partial isometries on every irreducible isotypic component. It verifies multiplication and involution using the noncommutative factor-system tensor relations and the conjugate-representation decomposition. A conditional-expectation/Hilbert-module argument then extends the dense Peter-Weyl construction to the full C-star algebra, so the lifting criterion is more than a formal algebraic conjugacy test.
source_version: Official SIGMA 18 (2022) article 015, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2022.015; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256

proof_review.method: Published author proof/core and local context fidelity screening
proof_review.note: The full Theorem4.1 proof, including Lemmas4.3–4.5 and the completion step, is supplied. A is a unital C-star algebra with a jointly continuous free action of compact G in the Ellwood/Peter-Weyl sense, B=A^G, and beta is a star automorphism of B. A lift means a star automorphism of A extending beta and commuting with every alpha_g. The criterion is conjugacy of the full factor system with its beta twist, via normalized partial isometries and the precise tensor/cocycle equations; mere equality of K0 characteristic classes is only a necessary condition and is not claimed sufficient. Existing free-action/factor-system reconstruction theory [36] is background; the author actually constructs and checks the new lift and extends it to the C-star completion. The later Abelian obstruction, one-parameter lifting and Atiyah-sequence variants are not separate counted units.
